---
title: "check-axis-titles.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, blocking check that flags an axis title made only of a symbol
or an expression.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-26) is that an axis title names the quantity
in plain words, and the symbol is optional:
"Probability, p" and "Log-odds, η", not "p", "z", "x1" or "f(x)".
This implements
[gha#1235](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1235).

The check reads these calls, on a line a pull request adds:

- ggplot2 `labs(x = "...", y = "...")`, including a call that spans lines,
  and `xlab("...")` and `ylab("...")`;
- ggplot2 titles given as `expression(...)` or `bquote(...)`,
  where only the quoted strings count as words,
  so `expression(f(x))` is flagged and `expression("Density, " * f(x))` is not;
- matplotlib `set_xlabel("...")`, `set_ylabel("...")` and `set_zlabel("...")`;
- plotly `xaxis_title`, `yaxis_title`, and `title` inside `xaxis = list(...)`
  or `yaxis = dict(...)` on one line.

A title is flagged when it holds no plain word.
After math spans (`$...$`) are dropped, a word is a run of three or more letters,
so "x", "x1", "f(x)" and "y h(x)" are flagged,
and "mpg", "Log-odds, η" and "Weight (lb)" are not.
`NULL`, a string with no letter or digit, and a title built from a variable
are not examined.

A justified exception puts `axis-title-ok: reason` anywhere on the line.
A comment with no reason does not exempt it.
Use `paths-ignore` to exempt whole paths.

## Scope

Only a title on a line a pull request adds is reported,
so existing figures are never reflagged.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff
counts as moved rather than new.
With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked file on purpose,
which measures how many titles a repository already carries.
Every run prints how many lines, files and titles it examined.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default       | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd *.Rmd *.R *.py'` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`          | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `true`        | Fail the workflow when an axis title has no plain word. Set `false` for warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`       | Scan every tracked file in full instead of only a PR's added lines. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`      | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-axis-titles.yml in your repo.
# Diff-scoped check: flags an axis title made only of a symbol or expression
# ("x", "f(x)") when a PR adds it. Name the quantity in plain words, or add axis-title-ok: reason.
# Blocking by default.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check axis titles

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-axis-titles.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   globs: '*.qmd *.Rmd *.R *.py'      # pathspecs to check (recursive)
    #   paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'   # skip known-noisy paths
    #   fail: true                             # set false to warn only (defaults to true)
    #   whole-tree: true                       # scan every file, not just a PR's additions
```

See
[`examples/check-axis-titles.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-axis-titles.yml)
for the full caller stub.
